name: io.github.tibuntu/renovate-mcp
description: MCP server for designing Renovate configurations interactively.

environmentVariables.name: RENOVATE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Renovate platform token for the home platform (see docs/security.md).

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_COM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Read-only GitHub token for github.com dependency lookups and presets.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token, used only for the github.com host or the configured GitHub home.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab token, used only for the gitlab.com host or the configured GitLab home.

environmentVariables.name: GITEA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Gitea token, used only for the gitea.com host or the configured Gitea home.

environmentVariables.name: FORGEJO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Forgejo token, used only for the code.forgejo.org host or the configured Forgejo home.

environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bitbucket token, used only for the bitbucket.org host or the configured Bitbucket home.

environmentVariables.name: RENOVATE_PLATFORM
environmentVariables.description: Home platform (github, gitlab, gitea, forgejo, bitbucket) that binds the platform token.

environmentVariables.name: RENOVATE_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: API endpoint of a self-hosted home platform, used with RENOVATE_PLATFORM.

environmentVariables.name: RENOVATE_MCP_HOST_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of {matchHost, hostType, tokenEnv} entries binding extra host-scoped tokens by env var name (see docs/security.md).

environmentVariables.name: RENOVATE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path of the renovate binary to spawn instead of the bundled one.

environmentVariables.name: RENOVATE_CONFIG_VALIDATOR_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path of the renovate-config-validator binary to spawn instead of the bundled one.
